TWO EXISTING RESTFUL HTTP METHODS
GET /policies
http://127.0.0.1:8041/policies
Retrieves the approved-policy collection; no request body. The
Library formats its JSON array as rows.
200 OK authenticated, retained result H04
POST /ask
http://127.0.0.1:8041/ask
Sends JSON and creates fixture conversation, message and
clarification records; returns guidance and IDs.
200 OK retained results H07–H09

VERIFIED / LOCAL
AI API INTEGRATION 1 / ASSIGNMENT 1
Identity before access.
Authentication failures and successful requests prove different things.
401 ≠ 200
A Swagger 401 response demonstrates rejection of missing/invalid credentials. It does not show successful retrieval, a saved
question, or a returned policy answer. Success is established separately by the earlier automated 200 transcripts and UI captures.
Image availability: the user-referenced Swagger 401 files were not located. No Swagger screenshot is claimed; the authentic H02
transcript below independently proves rejection.
AUTHENTIC RETAINED 401 / TRANSCRIPT H02
GET http://127.0.0.1:8041/policies
Accept: application/json
Authorization: absent · Body: none
401 Unauthorized
WWW-Authenticate: Bearer
Content-Type: application/json
{
"detail": "Authentication required"
}
Authentication: the successful local requests used the existing development-only, loopback signed-token provider. The server resolves
identity and enforces role/ownership checks; a body-supplied user ID cannot override the token. This does not verify production Supabase
sign-in.
Status 200 OK What the retained evidence demonstrates
Authenticated GET returns policy JSON; POST processes the question. Existing POST contract uses 200, not 201.
H04/H07–H09.
401 Unauthorized 422 / 403 / 404 Missing bearer credentials rejected; authentication challenge returned. H02.
Invalid question fields / identity mismatch / another employee's private conversation denied. H10–H12.
ALL FOUR SUPPLIED CRITERIA / SUPPORTED
1. GET + POST: H04/H07–H09, B02/B06. 2. Formatted display: B01/B03–B05.
3. Structured exchanges: api-evidence.md + retained JSON. JSON source observations are also retained.
4. Secured API and friendly output: H02/H03/H11/H12 + B01–B07; public
PostgreSQL search was mocked to no matches; this answer is deterministic clarification, not a live LLM result. Production data,
authentication and external AI remain unverified. No mandatory new screenshot or runtime test is required by the supplied rubric.
